# ADR-3279: AWS tagging_compute: Shared SSH keypair across fleet for env 7

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Shared keys complicate rotation and attribution.

## Decision

Fleets MUST NOT reuse a shared SSH keypair across fleet for env 7 (AWS-tagging_compute-7).

## Consequences

Prefer SSM Session Manager without SSH keys.
